single_root.name: MISSING_INDEPENDENT_SAME_FUNCTION_CAUSAL_EVALUATION_CONTRACT
single_root.statement: Cannot compare actual LLM and deterministic EC on the same meaning-bearing function with independently grounded gold, strictly identical pre-target inputs, and target-only changes; hence cannot localize a nondegrading replacement boundary.
single_root.why_more_tests_no_progress: Prior formal48 48/48 verifies formal policy conformance with self-authored labels, not independent NL semantics. Prior next-action 17/17 vs 1/17 is a different governed singleton function and an exposed development set. Both are useful diagnostics but cannot satisfy original full S1–S4 A–E.
